placements.why: Documents the strategic architectural decision to switch the analytics database from Zypherion to Meridian to address critical streaming ingestion gaps with native batch and streaming capabilities, superseding the prior Zypherion adoption.
placements.title: Switching to Meridian for Native Batch and Streaming Analytics
placements.frame: Why is the analytics pipeline transitioning to Meridian, and how does native streaming support justify superseding Zypherion?
